meta.title: Freight Transport and Logistics Services | Transgarant
meta.description: FTL, LTL and specialised freight transport in Lithuania and Europe, including ADR, air, sea, warehousing and customs solutions.

hero.title: Services for every stage of your shipment
hero.description: From a few pallets to a full or specialised load, we select the transport, plan the route and coordinate delivery to the consignee.

explorer.title: Choose a service
explorer.intro: Every shipment is assessed individually. Select a service to see how we can plan your cargo journey.

services.title: Road freight
services.heading: Full, partial and small-load road transport
services.intro: We organise domestic and international road freight, from a single pallet to a dedicated vehicle.
paragraphs: For full loads, we select the vehicle according to cargo dimensions, weight and delivery schedule. A direct route reduces unnecessary handling and provides clearer delivery control.
For partial and small loads, we consolidate cargo so you pay for the capacity you need rather than an entire vehicle. We coordinate collection, documents and door-to-door delivery.
services.imageAlt: Truck prepared for international road freight

services.title: Specialised cargo
services.heading: When standard transport is not enough
services.intro: We prepare an individual transport solution for cargo with additional safety, temperature or dimensional requirements.
paragraphs: Dangerous and temperature-sensitive cargo is planned according to its classification, required temperature range, documentation and vehicle specification.
For oversized cargo, we assess dimensions, weight, route restrictions, permits and suitable equipment. Every such shipment is coordinated individually.
services.imageAlt: Specialised vehicle prepared for demanding cargo

services.title: Air and sea freight
services.heading: Solutions for urgent and international shipments
services.intro: When road transport is not the best option, we organise air, sea or multimodal freight routes.
paragraphs: Air freight is suitable for urgent, valuable and smaller shipments where transit time matters most. We coordinate collection, the flight route and final delivery.
Sea freight suits larger volumes and international supply chains. We select the appropriate shipping format and connect port handling with inland transport.
services.imageAlt: Freight containers and transport at a sea terminal

services.title: Warehousing and customs
services.heading: Safe storage and preparation for the next stage
services.intro: We organise warehousing, handling, reloading and customs services to keep cargo moving smoothly between transport stages.
paragraphs: Depending on the cargo, we arrange standard or temperature-controlled premises. Temporary storage, consolidation, reloading and preparation for dispatch can be coordinated.
Where customs formalities apply, we coordinate the required services and information flow between the parties involved.
services.imageAlt: Modern logistics warehouse with prepared cargo

services.title: International moving
services.heading: Moving property and belongings between countries
services.intro: We organise international relocation transport for companies and private clients, coordinating collection, transport and delivery times.
paragraphs: Before transport, we assess volume, packing needs, loading conditions and the delivery address, then select the appropriate vehicle and route.
One responsible coordinator manages the information and shipment flow so each stage stays aligned and the client knows what is happening.
services.imageAlt: Cargo prepared for an international relocation

services.title: Freight forwarding
services.heading: One contact throughout the cargo journey
services.intro: We combine transport, routing, documents and communication into one clearly managed shipment process.
paragraphs: Based on the cargo, schedule and budget, we select suitable carriers and transport modes. A trusted partner network enables flexible planning in Lithuania and abroad.
We oversee the order from enquiry to delivery, resolve operational questions and provide the client with relevant shipment information.
services.imageAlt: Logistics specialist coordinating an international shipment
